I grow beans mainly to help the soil and for some extra food for my children, but maize is what keeps us from hunger, so my FISP coupon will go to the maize field. Beans do not need chemical fertilizer the way maize does, and I do not have money to buy pesticides or to pay workers. I will plant seed I kept from last season, and my family will do all the weeding and harvesting by hand when the rains arrive.
